description: React component for managing email event notification settings, including fetching, updating, resetting, and displaying user-configurable email notifications related to various email events.

methods.name: fetchEventSettings
methods.description: Fetches email event settings from the backend and updates component state

methods.name: handleCheckboxChange
methods.description: Handles toggling the enabled state for a specific email event

methods.name: handleSaveSettings
methods.description: Saves the current email event settings to the backend

methods.name: handleResetSettings
methods.description: Resets email event settings to default values via the backend

methods.name: getEventDescription
methods.description: Generates a descriptive string for each email event type
